question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

DIFFERENCE
solution:
The correct answer is **'Similarity'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Difference: **the way that people or things are not the same or the way that somebody/something has changed. (अंतर, भेद, फ़र्क़​)

 
 
• ***Example:**** ***What is the difference between this keyboard and that costlier one?
 
 
 
• *​** *****Similarity: ** the state of being almost the same, or a particular way in which something is almost the same. (समानता​)
 
 
• ***Example:* ** Even though there are many ***similarities ***between men and women, there remain many differences.
 
 
 
• Thus, we can say that **Difference **and **Similarity** are **antonyms**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The meaning of the other words__:
 
• **Contrast**: a clear difference between two things or people that are seen when they are compared.
 
• ** Distinction**: a clear or important difference between things or people.
 
• ** Acceptance: **the act of accepting or being accepted.
